about: Main dimensions of the 50 cm TARS. Fusion user parameters are created from these expressions (same names, same formulas); the simulator's body spec is derived from the same values. Height is fixed; `baby` widens and deepens the body without making it taller. `parts` are bought parts placed as blocks: size along x (depth), y (width), z (up) in the parent component's frame, with their real mass.

parameters.name: height
parameters.comment: total height, fixed

parameters.name: baby
parameters.comment: multiplier on depth and widths only; 1.1 = 10 % wider and deeper

parameters.name: base_depth
parameters.comment: depth before baby (36 cm sim body: 9 cm / 36 cm)

parameters.name: base_central_w
parameters.comment: central slab width before baby (9 / 36)

parameters.name: base_arm_w
parameters.comment: each arm's width before baby (4.5 / 36)

parameters.name: depth
parameters.comment: front to back, all slabs

parameters.name: central_w
parameters.comment: central slab width

parameters.name: arm_w
parameters.comment: each arm's width

parameters.name: arm_gap
parameters.comment: clearance between central slab and each arm; not scaled

parameters.name: total_w
parameters.comment: overall width, derived

parameters.name: hinge_z
parameters.comment: hinge axis height above the floor (A39: through the centre)

parameters.name: arm_offset
parameters.comment: sideways distance from the centre line to each arm's centre, derived

parameters.name: wall_t
parameters.comment: printed wall thickness (PETG); a first guess, tune when printing

parameters.name: bat_l
parameters.comment: DXF 4S 5200 mAh: length (stands upright in central)

parameters.name: bat_w
parameters.comment: DXF 4S 5200 mAh: width

parameters.name: bat_h
parameters.comment: DXF 4S 5200 mAh: height

parameters.name: bat_mass
parameters.comment: DXF 4S 5200 mAh: mass (seller: about 480 g +-15)

parameters.name: cam_baseline
parameters.comment: distance between the two cameras' centres; the widest the central slab's front allows (the hand-held rig has 134 mm)

parameters.name: petg_density
parameters.comment: PETG density in g/cm3 (typical filament datasheet value)

parameters.name: carrier_gap
parameters.comment: clearance between the carrier box and the inside of the arm sleeve (room for rails)

parameters.name: carrier_d
parameters.comment: carrier box depth: fits inside the arm sleeve

parameters.name: carrier_w
parameters.comment: carrier box width

parameters.name: carrier_h
parameters.comment: carrier box height: holds the slide servo, drive pulley and idlers; tall so the rails' bearing span keeps loads on it low (2026-11-06)

parameters.name: hinge_range
parameters.comment: each hinge turns +-hinge_range: past 180 deg either way, so either end of an arm can be the foot (clockwise and counterclockwise); the slide servo's cable must twist this far

parameters.name: slide_travel
parameters.comment: how far the sleeve can slide each way before its end wall meets the carrier, derived

parts.name: battery
parts.comment: upright, centred, on the floor of the central slab: lowest centre of mass
parts.source: DXF 4S 5200 mAh, Amazon.se B0B9K69TMQ: 138 x 47 x 48.5 mm, about 480 g

parts.name: pi5
parts.source: 85 x 56 mm board (retailers); 20 mm with cooler and 50 g are estimates (listings say 45-62 g)
parts.comment: upright against the back wall, just above the battery

parts.name: hinge_servo_left
parts.source: STS3250, Feetech store on Alibaba: 45.22 x 24.72 x 35 mm, 74.5 g
parts.comment: on the hinge axis, output shaft pointing out along +y

parts.name: hinge_servo_right
parts.source: STS3250, Feetech store on Alibaba: 45.22 x 24.72 x 35 mm, 74.5 g
parts.comment: on the hinge axis, output shaft pointing out along -y

parts.name: imu
parts.comment: on the hinge centre, between the hinge servos

parts.name: bus_board_12v
parts.comment: back wall, above the Pi; drives the two STS3250 (12 V bus)

parts.name: bus_board_7v4
parts.comment: back wall, above the Pi; drives the two STS3215-C046 (7.4 V bus)

parts.name: buck_5v
parts.source: estimate: the Zorblix page gives no size or weight
parts.comment: back wall; 5 V 5 A for the Pi

parts.name: buck_12v
parts.source: DollaTek 300 W 20 A, Amazon.se B083PZDF17: 60 x 53 x 27 mm, 0.09 kg

parts.name: buck_7v4
parts.source: DollaTek 300 W 20 A, Amazon.se B083PZDF17: 60 x 53 x 27 mm, 0.09 kg
parts.comment: upper central, flat, above the 12 V one

parts.name: screen
parts.source: 121 x 78 mm (Waveshare 5inch HDMI LCD, which the AliExpress listing copies); 12 mm thick and 120 g are estimates
parts.comment: the face, behind the front wall

parts.name: respeaker
parts.source: ReSpeaker Lite: 86 x 35 x 9.4 mm, 21 g (retailers)
parts.comment: front, above the screen, mics facing forward

parts.name: slide_servo
parts.source: STS3215(-C046): 45.2 x 24.7 x 35 mm, 55 g (retailers; the C046 weight is the generic STS3215's)
parts.comment: in the arm's inner box on the hinge axis; drives the belt (one component, so both arms get one)
